project_identity.name: MikiLab
project_identity.description: Cohesive, reusable 'clean & ordered' visual design system for MikiLab — a free gamified home-baker & professional bakery PWA (React + Tailwind).
project_identity.design_archetype: Warm Artisan Bakery Modern Minimalist (Deep Dark + Warm Wood + Vibrant Orange Accent)
project_identity.primary_viewport: Mobile-first PWA (~430px width, fluidly scaling to desktop grid)

i18n_support.rtl_protocol: Use Tailwind logical properties (ms-*, me-*, ps-*, pe-*, start-*, end-*) and dir='rtl' wrapper attributes to ensure clean Persian layout.

project_identity.monetization: 100% Free app (No paywalls or premium gates)

motion_and_interactions.hover_effects: Subtle 2px lift (-translate-y-0.5), glowing border transition, subtle scale up of card background image (scale-105).
motion_and_interactions.entrance_animations: Staggered fade-in-up using Framer Motion (delayChildren: 0.1, staggerChildren: 0.05).
motion_and_interactions.reduced_motion: respect prefers-reduced-motion by replacing smooth translation with instant opacity transitions

accessibility_and_rtl.contrast_ratio: Minimum 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large display headers and buttons
accessibility_and_rtl.rtl_rules: Under RTL (FA), margin-left becomes margin-right, flex-row order flips logically, text aligns right natively
accessibility_and_rtl.testing_attributes: All buttons, tabs, input cards, and interactive blocks MUST include data-testid='...' in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Maintain the warm bakery mood (deep dark #121212, warm wood accents #A66E38, vibrant warm orange #FF6B00).
2. Make the layout clean, spacious, and modern with generous internal card padding and clear typographic hierarchy.
3. Apply this design system across the whole app, starting with the 5-section Home Hub, Bottom Nav, and PWA Share & Install banner.
5. Ensure full multi-language RTL compliance when FA (Persian) is active.
6. Keep all interactive elements equipped with explicit data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do NOT use pure black #000000 or harsh neon colors. Tint darks to warm dark (#121212, #181716).
Never hide header or bottom nav behind missing borders or zero backdrop-blur.
Ensure contrast ratios meet WCAG AA specifications across all buttons and inputs.
Include data-testid on all interactive buttons, cards, links, tabs, and form components.
